declaration.goal: Crawl ahead by 0.3 to 0.5 m, keeping within 0.2 m of the start line and within 20 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.text: WHEN one control channel (c0) is driven by a 1 Hz sine of amplitude 1 and the other four are zero, THE system SHALL end with a net x displacement smaller than 0.3 m.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c0 sine 1Hz: x=3.9e-5 m, no motion. Inside predicted range [-0.3,0.3]. c1: also ~0 (x=2.5e-5). c2: x=0.027, y=0.024, heading 22.9 deg, with a 1 Hz oscillation in track_x of about 0.03 m amplitude and heading drifting upward. So c2 moves the body a little and turns it; c0 and c1 do almost nothing alone. The picture shows a small body with an arm, nearly stationary. No net crawl of 0.3 m yet.

words.text: H2 predicted x in [0.1,0.6] for c3 alone. Measured x=-0.028 m (c3), 0.002 (c4), 0.014 (c3+c4 with heading 67.6 deg). No channel alone gives crawl; each gives ~0.01-0.03 m wiggle at the 1 Hz drive frequency and small heading changes. c3+c4 together turned the body 67 deg.

statement.author: dr-kiro

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: H3 predicted x in [0.1,0.6] with c0=c1=1 constant and c2,c3,c4 sines. Measured x=-0.017 (c0 and c1 const), -0.027 (c0 only), -0.037 (c1 only); y 0.12-0.15, heading 113-123 deg. Constants on c0/c1 make no clear difference to results, so they are not enable or gain. In-phase sines on c2,c3,c4 spin the body about 120 deg with no forward crawl.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c3 is a 1 Hz sine and c4 leads it by 90 degrees with c0, c1 and c2 at zero, THE system SHALL end with x between 0.1 and 0.6 m and heading within 30 degrees of zero.

Measured x=-0.018 (T10), 0.033 (T11), 0.016 (T12); heading stayed within 15 deg and y within 0.06 m, but net forward travel stayed below 0.04 m, so the 0.3-0.5 m goal was not reached.
